news.headline: Teradyne to Present at the 2026 UBS Global Technology and AI Conference
news.summary: NORTH READING, Mass., November 16, 2026--Teradyne, Inc. (NASDAQ:TER) today announced that Greg Smith, Chief Executive Officer, is scheduled to participate in a fireside chat at the UBS Global Technology and AI Conference on Monday, November 30, 2026, at 4:15 PM MST.

news.headline: Teradyne Stocks Drop 6.14% as Advantest's 11% Tokyo Plunge Hits Chip Testers
news.summary: Teradyne fell in sympathy with its largest rival after Tokyo's chip selloff, a quarter after AI demand lifted its revenue 70%.

news.headline: Vertiv vs. Teradyne: Which AI Infrastructure Stock Is the Better Buy?
news.summary: VRT emerges as a stronger AI infrastructure stock than TER, supported by robust order growth, a diversified portfolio, and stronger earnings estimate revisions.

news.headline: Robotics Stocks Become a Stock-Picker’s Market as Momentum and Fundamentals Diverge
news.summary: Robotics and automation stocks show high-quality fundamentals but weak momentum, with sharp divergence between earnings and share prices.
